fields.label: Source platform execution account reference
fields.help: Protected secret-store record for the scoped execution identity. Supply its record identifier, never its secret value.

fields.label: Source platform verification account reference
fields.help: Separate read-only identity used to verify effects independently of the execution account.

fields.label: Destination platform execution account reference
fields.help: Protected secret-store record for the scoped execution identity. Supply its record identifier, never its secret value.

fields.label: Destination platform verification account reference
fields.help: Separate read-only identity used to verify effects independently of the execution account.

fields.label: Image transfer execution account reference
fields.help: Protected secret-store record for the scoped execution identity. Supply its record identifier, never its secret value.

fields.label: Image transfer verification account reference
fields.help: Separate read-only identity used to verify effects independently of the execution account.

fields.label: Account permissions and scope record
fields.help: Approved projects, datacentres, resource scope, expiry and permissions for all six accounts.

fields.label: TLS trust and rotation record
fields.help: Approved certificate authorities, endpoint identity checks, secret rotation and revocation procedure.

fields.label: Independent recovery custody record
fields.help: Owner and protected provider state used to reconcile effects after a worker or journal restore.

fields.label: Stale worker exclusion procedure
fields.help: How the platform prevents a revoked or restored worker from issuing further native changes.

fields.label: Capacity and address reservation procedure
fields.help: Reserve, confirm, reconcile and release capacity, IP addresses and service allocations.

fields.label: Guest preparation recipe
fields.help: Reviewed image, driver and hardening recipe, including the tested converter image when applicable.

fields.label: Shared service integration procedures
fields.help: Owner protocols for DNS, IPAM, identity, time, trust, logging, monitoring and backup.

fields.label: Transfer and concurrency measurement record
fields.help: Measured route throughput, API limits, phase concurrency and current resource capacity. Supply the retained observation reference.

fields.label: Application consistency procedure
fields.help: Application owner procedure for quiescing writes and establishing a consistent migration baseline.

fields.label: Data synchronization method record
fields.help: Selected application/file delta or cold-export method, scope and owner acceptance. Record an explicit cold-export decision when no delta is used.

fields.label: Application writer isolation procedure
fields.help: How source and destination writers are fenced at cutover, with independent verification.

fields.label: Traffic switch and policy validation procedure
fields.help: Approved traffic change plus application tests and allowed/denied network-path verification.

fields.label: Backup and restore validation record
fields.help: Restoration of application data, attachments and dependencies, with retained original results.

fields.label: Recovery before and after destination writes
fields.help: Separate source-return and post-write recovery procedures, including data reconciliation.

fields.label: Retirement and retention authorization
fields.help: Owner-approved retention of source data and keys, deletion authority and cleanup verification.

fields.label: Approved operating objectives record
fields.help: Accountable owner's acceptance of the targets below and representative workload used to measure them.

fields.label: Authorized qualification campaign
fields.help: Exact lab scope and campaign authorization for native Q05–Q10 observations.

fields.label: Installed release and artifact record
fields.help: Installed candidate digest, signed component versions, trust roots and mirror closure.

fields.label: Security findings and custody assessment
fields.help: Actual application-security results, required finding dispositions and jurisdiction/custody review.

fields.label: Alert routing and escalation record
fields.help: Receiving route, acknowledgement objective, on-call rota and tested escalation evidence.

fields.label: Receiving team and independent reviewers
fields.help: Named operations, security, application and qualification reviewers with responsibilities and conflict checks.

fields.label: Support and operational rehearsal record
fields.help: Support ownership, operator rehearsal, patching, retained evidence and accessibility receiving checks.

fields.label: Maximum application outage (seconds)
fields.help: Owner-approved outage limit. Zero means no outage is permitted.

fields.label: Maximum data loss (bytes)
fields.help: Owner-approved data-loss limit. Zero means no data loss is permitted.

fields.label: Recovery time objective (seconds)
fields.help: Maximum accepted time to recover the service after a failure.

fields.label: Maximum simultaneous migrations
fields.help: Planning limit for the representative workload; admission still requires current measurements.
